title: When the Protocol Burns Anew
author: Paloma Okafor
blurb: Silas Yarrow, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
